meta.rule: A number without a public source cannot sit on this blotter.
meta.disclaimer: Decisions below cite public Coinupbtc reports. Hardware is NVIDIA DGX Spark. Not a trading product. Not a MiaAI Labs repo.

respect.what: Published the Qwen3.6-35B UD-Q8_K_XL Spark serve recipe we used as the serving baseline for the 35B cards.
respect.scope: Credit is for that recipe only — not for zwell-bench, this ledger, or other work.

cards.title: BALANCED v8 ngram-mod on 35B
cards.hypothesis: draft-mtp + ngram-mod + ngram-simple (order matters) beats ngram-simple alone without a quality drop.
cards.also: refactor 34 → 264 tok/s · bench_v5 19/19 · live exclusive confirm
cards.why: Same model, same box, flags only. Quality held. This is the incumbent 35B profile.
cards.lesson: Spec list order is load-bearing: ngram-simple before ngram-mod shadows the win.

cards.title: Thinking off for interactive 35B
cards.hypothesis: Default CoT burns wall-clock without moving the 9/10 quality rubric.
cards.also: coding quality 9.0/10 both sides · long TTFT ~7–8s @ 9.5k tok
cards.why: Biggest interactive win was a client flag, not another engine rebuild.
cards.lesson: Measure wall-clock and quality on the same prompt set. Speed without a rubric is a vibe.

cards.title: cache-reuse on this llama.cpp build
cards.hypothesis: Repeat calls with a stable prefix would skip KV reprocessing.
cards.metric: repeat TTFT == cold TTFT (~5.6–6.0s @ ~9.2k) in 3/3 configs
cards.also: slot matched (sim_best 0.182) yet no KV-shift · canary fresh 3/3
cards.why: Silent no-op. Shipping it would have looked like a cache win in the unit file and done nothing.
cards.lesson: Journal the slot match AND the TTFT. Presence of a flag is not integrity of a speedup.

cards.title: ub2048 concurrent prefill
cards.hypothesis: Larger ubatch would pay for itself under mixed chat + long prefill.
cards.metric: small-chat during big PP: 2.16s TTFT / 17.4 tok/s vs ub1024 0.9s / 46.6
cards.also: Rejected twice. Solo decode also slipped on the first pass.
cards.why: Starves the interactive lane. Lever closed until the architecture changes.
cards.lesson: Never score a prefill knob on a quiet box only. Concurrent TTFT is the user.

cards.title: fp16 KV on 35B
cards.instrument: Qwen3.6-35B · fp16 KV vs q8_0 KV
cards.hypothesis: q8_0 dequant is the decode bottleneck.
cards.why: Same-conditions A/B. The hypothesis was wrong. Keep q8_0.
cards.lesson: A prettier KV type is not a speedup. Kill it in public so nobody retries it as folklore.

cards.title: gpt-oss-120b as daily driver
cards.hypothesis: A smarter model should replace the 35B incumbent.
cards.metric: hard6 6/6 (5–29s/item) · coding 41.5 tok/s vs live v8 169.4
cards.also: makespan item both Qwen engines failed · bench_v5 16/19 unadjudicated (no transcripts)
cards.why: Better at hard reasoning, worse at the cron/chat speed budget. Specialist, not a replacement.
cards.lesson: Split verdicts stay HOLD until the job is named. Do not average two different uses into one winner.

cards.title: Objective bakeoff harness (zwell-bench)
cards.hypothesis: Chat screenshots are not a bakeoff. Executed coding + exact JSON + tool choice are.
cards.metric: Harness ships with coding (executed), extraction, vision, tools, agentic order
cards.why: A recipe that starts is not a model that passes. The harness is the other half of the desk.
cards.lesson: If the grader cannot fail, you are not measuring.
